ideas.title: GLP-1 mode
ideas.body: If you take a GLP-1 medicine, turn on one switch in Settings › You and your goal. The morning check-in gains two optional taps, Queasy today and Not hungry today: either one makes a good day's session gentler, and the food card puts protein first with a reminder to have small meals and plenty to drink. Udapt never asks for your medicine, dose or timing, and never advises on them.

ideas.title: Unwell days, and a gentle way back
ideas.body: Tap Unwell or travelling? on Today and say whether it's a cold or a fever, chest or aching all over. Udapt makes it a rest day and keeps your food target steady; when you tap I'm better, your first sessions back are lighter for a week.

ideas.title: Travelling
ideas.body: Shorter sessions of about 20 to 30 minutes, with exercises you can do in a hotel room where there are any, and a steady food target. Udapt offers this when your iPhone changes time zone.

ideas.title: A real lighter week
ideas.body: After a third rough day in a row, Udapt offers a lighter week: fewer sets and easier effort for seven days, then back to normal.

ideas.title: Setup with photos, and Replay setup
ideas.body: Setup now has photos, and Settings › Replay setup walks you through it again with your answers filled in.
